# Melo

Melo provides a comprehensive API for accessing real-time, deduplicated real estate listings and market analytics across France.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/melo/.

## Actions

- **Get Cities** (read-only): Retrieve a list of cities with optional filters.
- **List Searches** (read-only): List all searches.
- **Location Autocomplete** (read-only): Fetch location autocomplete suggestions.
- **Simulate Webhook**: Simulate sending a webhook event.
